# JPEG fixture

`testorig.jpg` is the upstream libjpeg-turbo test image:
https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/blob/main/testimages/testorig.jpg

Upstream licensing is retained in `LICENSE-libjpeg-turbo.md`.
PNG codec fixtures are independently generated by `tests/run_image_tests.py`
using Python's standard library, including PNG filters and Adam7 interlacing.
